title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 39 ]

items.text: The IMF is unhappy with the government's handling of the economy.
The trade barrier did not stop businesses from selling the car.
I know a new Korean restaurant that opened recently.
It's becoming harder to find others who share the belief.
The mother whose children work hard is happy.
This is the book (which) I bought yesterday.
I sympathize with the girl (whom) he raped.
The teacher by whom I am taught English is very kind.
The house in which he lives is very large.
This is the chair on which I sit.
The sculptures which you are looking at are masterpieces.
Weather reports are very important to people who plan the routes of ships and airplanes.
